title: Doctor required-gate coverage ignores declared command and observable constraints
description: Runtime closeout gate matching enforces declaredCommand and expectedObservable, but doctorRequiredGateSatisfied only checks kind/status/count. Imported or manually corrupted terminal records can pass strict doctor even when required command/observable evidence is absent.
acceptanceCriteria: Doctor required-gate coverage reuses the runtime declared-gate matcher or equivalent declaredCommand/expectedObservable checks.
Strict doctor emits declared-command and expected-observable diagnostics for mismatches.
Regression fixtures cover command mismatch and expected observable mismatch on closed terminal work.
